source_name: INEGI DENUE — Directorio Estadístico Nacional de Unidades Económicas
organization: Instituto Nacional de Estadística y Geografía (INEGI)
rate_limits: bulk CSV needs no token; the query API needs a free INEGI token
notes: National statistical directory of economic units (establishments). Per-state CSV bulk is openly downloadable (denue_{EE}_csv.zip, EE=01..32; 00=national). Verified: Aguascalientes 71,871 units, 42 cols. Fields: trade name, legal name (raz_social, when applicable), SCIAN activity, employee band, address, geo. NO RFC, NO folio mercantil — establishment-level, join to other sources only by name. ~5M units nationally.

source_name: SAT Listado 69-B — taxpayers with presumed non-existent operations
notes: Open CSV of taxpayers presumed to have non-existent operations (EFOS, art. 69-B CFF), keyed on the RFC + legal name + situation (Presunto/Definitivo/Desvirtuado/Sentencia Favorable). Verified: 14,247 rows. Risk/compliance enrichment; not a company master. Join on RFC (12-char for companies).

source_name: Registro Público de Comercio (RPC/SIGER) & PSM publications
rate_limits: search/notice portal; certified extracts are fee-based
notes: The legal commercial registry: companies identified by folio mercantil electrónico. PSM publishes incorporation notices (constitutive acts); RPC/SIGER holds the registry. No open bulk/API found; certified extracts (boletas registrales) are fee-based. The authoritative legal identity (denominación, tipo societario, capital, objeto social), but not openly bulk-available. Cataloged from public docs.

organization: Bolsa Mexicana de Valores / Comisión Nacional Bancaria y de Valores
notes: Financial statements for LISTED companies (issuers) via BMV (EMISNET) and CNBV (SITI), XBRL/Excel, MXN. The only open financial route for Mexico, and only for issuers (a few hundred). Private-company financials are not public. Join by name/ticker. Not fetched here.

rate_limits: portal revamped; legacy CKAN busca/api returns HTML (404 for JSON)
notes: National open-data portal (Libre Uso MX licence). Catalogs many government datasets but the legacy CKAN API endpoint no longer returns JSON; does not openly host the legal company register. INEGI DENUE and SAT files are obtained directly from their own sites.
